universal_lens: The Trench Funnel unifies biophysical drag, roster attrition, and market microstructure into a single constrained optimization manifold. By mapping environmental density and injury-induced depth changes onto a shared state-space, we isolate the true pressure-leverage vector, decoupling fundamental on-field mechanics from exogenous cognitive noise.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal inference to bound the uncertainty of projected snap shares given Elliott's absence. Bayesian priors derived from Kalshi Layer-1 anchors are updated via live NGS tracking metrics (RYOE), yielding calibrated probability distributions for interior pressure rates and deep-ball carry distances.
gse_mapping: GSE models the game as a continuous-time Markov chain where offensive line continuity dictates transition probabilities. A drop below 80% continuity acts as a regime switch, increasing the expected value of interior pressure states while compressing second-half pace dynamics.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Trench Funnel thesis constructs a multi-layered operator by fusing biophysical constraints with roster attrition. First, the aerodynamic density shift operator establishes the baseline physical environment. At 1.2667 kg/m^3, the drag force on a football increases relative to sea-level standards, mathematically depressing the expected value of deep passing games and kicking accuracy. This forms the foundational 'environmental kernel' of our projection.

Second, the trench continuity funnel introduces a dynamic, discrete-state variable. The absence of Teven Jenkins (CLE) and Jordan Elliott (TEN) creates a structural weakness in the line-of-scrimmage equilibrium. We model this as a reduction in offensive line continuity (C). When C falls below the 80% threshold, the system undergoes a phase transition: interior pressure rates spike, and the overall game pace compresses in the second half. This directly impacts the snap-share distribution and scheme leverage.

Third, the microstructural Layer-1 anchor provides the probabilistic boundary conditions. The Kalshi print of 0.49 serves as an independent, de-vigged prior. By cross-referencing this with the Pinnacle guest line, we validate the stability of the market's expectation. If the physical and roster-based adjustments (L2 signals) diverge significantly from this anchor, it flags a stale book or an overreaction to cognitive noise, such as the narrative regarding Tennessee's pass rush.

Finally, live tracking data (RYOE = 22.6 for Bhayshul Tuten) offers real-time verification of the trench mechanics. This empirical observable allows us to continuously update the Bayesian posterior of the game script, ensuring our projections remain grounded in actual on-field efficiency rather than historical proxies.
